en: A black-and-white postcard depicting a large, multi-storey building complex set in a forested, mountainous area. The architecture looks like an early 20th‑century Central European lodge or health home, with steep gabled roofs and many windows. Tall conifer trees stand in front of the buildings, and wooded hills rise in the background. At the bottom, there is a handwritten-style caption in German identifying the place as 'Erzgebirgsheim Wald – Bärenburg i. Sächs. Erzgeb.'
